name: token-meter
description: A one-line meter above the prompt: context fill, tokens, cost and rate limits, with nudges to /compact or /clear.

autoCompactAt.title: Auto-compact at context %
autoCompactAt.description: Run a compaction automatically after a turn ends with context at or above this %. Off by default (0): you only get nudges. Set e.g. 80 to turn it on.
